system.description: You are among the last of Caine's descendants, one of the Last Generations. Your vitae is so weak you may use only six of your ten Blood Traits to heal wounds, fuel Disciplines or raise Physical Attributes, and the cost for all such actions is doubled. Rising each night still costs only one Blood Trait. Your remaining four Blood Traits sustain you through the day and let you rise each night, but nothing more. You cannot sire progeny, and your blood cannot create ghouls or a blood bond, though you can father or bear children in the normal mortal fashion (albeit very rarely). Sunlight inflicts only lethal damage on you rather than aggravated damage, and you can eat and hold down normal food and drink for about an hour before vomiting it up. This Flaw already includes the effects of Thin Blood, worded slightly differently, so you may not also take the Thin Blood Flaw.
